architectural_redesign.concept: Tactical Hardware Command Center / Live Pipeline Accelerator
architectural_redesign.vibe: Elite academic research workbench meets high-velocity telemetry terminal. Rich cyan-and-obsidian glow, tactile micro-toggles, kinetic packet conduit, crystal glass sticky nav, and instant viva demonstration value.

new_sections.title: Interactive Beam Pipeline (Hero Visualizer)
new_sections.description: Canvas-driven real-time packet accelerator showing IoT Sensor Node streaming Ascon-AEAD128 frames through a noisy RF channel into all 4 receiver architectures. Dropped packets burn into red EMP rings; L1 freezes; L2 branches into cache buffers; L3 cascades skipped key vaults; L4 sparks the parallel counter-seek lane with zero pipeline pause.

new_sections.title: Sticky HUD Navigation & Live Telemetry Bar
new_sections.description: Floating glassmorphic strip (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#06090f]/80) anchored at the top with jump links (#pipeline, #controls, #lanes, #inspector, #benchmarks, #hardware, #sweep), running state pulse, quick start/pause trigger, and instant loss/sent badges.

new_sections.title: Viva Demo Quick Scenarios
new_sections.description: One-click interactive showcase scenarios for exam defense: 1) Single Drop (Breaks L1 instantly), 2) Burst Loss (Fills L2 cache / stresses L3 memory), 3) Out-of-Order UDP (Shows L3 & L4 reorder handling), 4) Replay Attack (Shows L4 128-bit bitmap rejection), 5) Clean Stream (All in sync baseline).

new_sections.title: Vivid 4-Way Receiver Lanes Matrix
new_sections.description: Redesigned cards with distinct lane LED badges, glowing accent tracing lines, animated status pill indicator, dual timeline tracks with hover magnification, and an interactive 'Why L4 Wins' comparative chip.

new_sections.title: Interactive Inspector & Leak Cryptanalysis Deck
new_sections.description: Tabbed or split terminal card with live hex byte breakdown, AEAD auth tag verification chip, payload ASCII display, and the memory-compromise snapshot visualizer with animated compromise bars.

new_sections.title: Telemetry Analytics & Automated Sweep Studio
new_sections.description: High-contrast Recharts live streams with enhanced neon stroke shadows, custom tactical tooltips, and the loss-rate sweep lab with progress telemetry.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT break or remove ANY existing data-testid attribute in any component. Automated regression suites depend on them strictly.
Implement the animated HeroPacketFlow component using HTML5 Canvas and React useEffect requestAnimationFrame loop for top-notch 60fps performance without DOM thrashing.

Introduce Viva demo scenario buttons (e.g. 'Test Single Drop', 'Test 5-Pkt Burst', 'Inject Replay Attack') that trigger simRef.current with preconfigured params so examiners can witness the exact failure/recovery dynamics in 1 click.
Add sticky navigation with jump links to make navigating the long research workbench frictionless on laptops and projectors.
Use JetBrains Mono and IBM Plex Sans fonts consistently with rich tactical color accents (#00f0ff cyan, #8b5cf6 violet, #f59e0b amber, #f43f5e rose, #10b981 emerald).
Keep all simulator logic in lib/sim.js and lib/hardware.js intact - all cryptographic behavior is real Ascon and must continue working seamlessly.
Ensure dark mode is deep and immersive (#06090f) with subtle micro-dots and crisp 1px borders, avoiding flat gray blankets.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is forbidden).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react icons exclusively.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
